Coverage_Description: Annual dental, general practice outpatient, or medical check-up healthcare services via appointed or any clinics/laboratories under a master group policy; participating providers may direct bill, while excluded or excess expenses are payable by the member
pricing: Enrollment fee: Dental HKD150 (appointed)/HKD80 (any); GP Outpatient HKD330 (appointed)/HKD80 (any)
customer requirement: Principal CCB (Asia) credit cardmember with valid account; complete enrollment/renewal form within 20 business days from card issuance
price structure: Plan-option enrollment fee, plus optional per-subscription and transfer service fees, with possible year-end administrative charge if card-u
additional informations: Only one core plan can be selected. Extra subscription applies only to Dental and Medical Check-up plans (up to 3 dependents). Benefit trans; eye card and Construction Industry UnionPay Dual Currency card are eligible for Dental plan only
